# Anumana

> An open-source MCP server for understanding database query plans, estimated
> costs and access patterns before executing a candidate query.

Canonical website: https://anumana.aolbeam.com/
Audience: developers, database practitioners, and AI coding agents drafting or
reviewing SQL, pgvector similarity searches and other supported native requests.
The website is documentation and setup guidance, not a hosted database service.

## What Anumana does

- Reads real schema, indexes and cached statistics where the engine exposes them.
- Uses planner-only operations such as PostgreSQL EXPLAIN to assess estimated
  work, scan strategy, risk tiers and overhead flags without executing candidates.
- Checks pgvector patterns including full-vector scans, excessive top-k,
  unbounded searches and metadata/filter interactions.
- Proposes candidate refinements and compares available planner estimates;
  semantic equivalence and actual runtime are not guaranteed.
- Provides plain-English explanations of query plans.
- Offers preflight_schema_only for limited heuristic SQL checks against supplied
  CREATE TABLE / CREATE INDEX DDL without a database connection.
- Includes a prepared agent skill with engine-specific workflows, connection
  templates, explicit readiness states and incremental verification checklists.

## Start here

- [Installation and local MCP configuration](https://anumana.aolbeam.com/#get-started):
  Configure a local server in an MCP-compatible agent; use your own read-only
  database connection for live checks. The baseline template pins 0.2.1.
- [How preflight works](https://anumana.aolbeam.com/#how-it-works):
  Read schema, draft a native query, inspect the plan, then refine and recheck.
- [Query examples](https://anumana.aolbeam.com/#examples):
  Illustrative PostgreSQL, vector-search and offline DDL scenarios, not live results.
- [Agent skill](https://anumana.aolbeam.com/#skill):
  The MCP supplies tools; the skill supplies their usage workflow. The Agensi
  listing is planned, not yet a published download or purchase link.
- [Skill setup](https://anumana.aolbeam.com/#use-skill):
  Keep SKILL.md and supporting resources together; server registration is separate.
- [Database readiness](https://anumana.aolbeam.com/#engines):
  Full list with adapter implementation, connected-runner and live-testing states.

## Documentation and package

- [Source and README](https://github.com/sinhaKAN-ra/anumana)
- [MCP tool contract](https://github.com/sinhaKAN-ra/anumana/blob/main/TOOL_SURFACE.md)
- [Engine status](https://github.com/sinhaKAN-ra/anumana/blob/main/SUPPORTED_ENGINES.md)
- [Published Python package](https://pypi.org/project/anumana-mcp/)
- [Issues](https://github.com/sinhaKAN-ra/anumana/issues)
- [MIT license](https://github.com/sinhaKAN-ra/anumana/blob/main/LICENSE)

Repository documentation can differ from unreleased local work. Inspect the
installed tool signatures and current engine status before relying on a feature.
MCP tool names: describe_schema_tool, preflight_query, preflight_vector_search,
preflight_schema_only, rewrite_query, suggest_query, explain_query_working,
list_targets, list_policies.

## Readiness and limitations

The site's development-checkout catalog covers 12 adapter families; this is NOT
12 verified live integrations or a published-release compatibility guarantee.

- PostgreSQL and SQLite have live test evidence for tested paths.
- pgvector, MySQL/MariaDB, MongoDB, DynamoDB and Amazon Redshift have connected
  runner paths with live verification pending.
- BigQuery, Snowflake, ClickHouse, FalkorDB and Cassandra/ScyllaDB have adapter
  code and prepared guidance but no live MCP runner in the current checkout.
- SQL preflight uses EXPLAIN, never EXPLAIN ANALYZE. There is no query execution
  tool. MongoDB schema discovery samples a document; it is not metadata-only.
- PostgreSQL planner cost is unitless, not milliseconds or dollars. SQLite,
  MongoDB and DynamoDB checks are heuristic access-pattern assessments.
- No guaranteed runtime, cost savings, SQL equivalence, ANN recall, or validated
  cloud billing. Adding LIMIT or switching to ANN can change results.
- HypoPG verification is optional development functionality requiring an already
  installed extension; it does not create real indexes. End-to-end live HypoPG
  verification remains pending. Do not assume unreleased features ship in 0.2.1.
- Keep database credentials local and out of chat, source control and reports.

## Related projects (separate products)

- [Aolbeam AI — learning and practice](https://www.aolbeam.com/practice):
  Practise maths, science, languages, humanities, business and coding with
  AI-generated questions, answer feedback and personal learning paths.
  Learning paths require sign-in; usage limits apply; AI content can make mistakes.
- [Ask](https://ask.aolbeam.com): A Python CLI for AI questions, code inspection
  and web search, using configured model/search providers. It does not execute
  generated commands or edit code.

These related products do not provide features of the Anumana MCP server.
